lead: Fish and seafood bought to eat at home, from fresh market species and shellfish to smoked fish, conservas, caviar, cured and dried fish and fish cakes; organised by product form, then species family, with named origins, houses and grades where buyers compare them.

b.v: MSC (wild) · ASC (farmed) · BAP · organic · none
b.w: Main eco-labels on retail seafood; MCS Good Fish Guide and Seafood Watch ratings rank species and stocks.

b.v: pole-and-line / hand-line / diver-caught › trawled; farmed vs wild
b.w: Drives quality and sustainability claims on labels.

b.v: PDO · PGI · TSG · national GI (Japan, Korea, China)
b.w: EU and Asian geographical-indication registers name the protected origins.

b.v: live › day-boat fresh › frozen-at-sea › refreshed (thawed)
b.w: Fishmonger and retail labelling; sashimi grade needs freezing or super-fresh handling.

depts.note: Tier for everyday white and farmed fish; named origins (PGI/GI) as archetypes where they exist.

b.v: clear eyes · red gills · firm flesh · sea smell
b.w: Standard fishmonger guidance.

b.v: whole · fillet · loin · steak · portion
b.w: How the fish is sold; recorded as types, not kinds.

s.brief: Merge the five Pacific salmon kinds into one kind with types sockeye/king (chinook)/coho/keta (chum)/pink. Archetypes by named origin: Scottish Farmed Salmon PGI, Scottish Wild Salmon PGI, Clare Island Salmon PGI, Copper River salmon (Alaska), Faroe Islands salmon, Loch Duart, Label Rouge Scottish salmon; keep existing PGIs/GIs (みやぎサーモン, Trentino trout and char, Szilvásvárad trout, Coracle-caught sewin) as archetypes or models. Trout types rainbow/brown/sea trout (sewin)/steelhead. Types for all: wild/farmed, whole/fillet/portion.
Restraint: kind-level species with types (fresh/frozen, fillet/loin, MSC). Hake absorbs white/red (phycid) hake as types plus Cape/Argentine/European hake. Whiting absorbs pouting. Ling absorbs tusk.

Restraint. Mackerel absorbs Atka mackerel (hokke) as a type, with Atlantic/chub types; keep Caballa de Andalucía PGI and Cornish Sardines PGI. Whitebait absorbs smelt (types shirasu, smelt, whitebait); keep Tagonoura shirasu GI once (dedupe English/Japanese entries).

k.brief: Rename from Scad; aliases scad · aji · jurel.

s.brief: Restraint. Tuna kinds get types for cut and grade (loin, steak, saku; akami/chutoro/otoro; sashimi grade) and catch method (pole-and-line, longline, ranched). Keep the Strait of Messina swordfish presidium as a model only if it is a sold product; otherwise mention as a type note.
Restraint. Plaice absorbs flounder (types plaice, European flounder, summer/winter flounder). Turbot types turbot/brill. Types whole/fillet.
Restraint. Sea bream absorbs black and red sea bream (types gilthead/dorade, black, red/madai). Grouper absorbs wreckfish/stone bass as a type.
Restraint. Keep carp PGIs/PDOs (Christmas carp traditions) and whitefish GIs (Lough Neagh pollan, Puruvesi muikku); fix 'Lough Neah' spelling. Catfish types channel/blue; pangasius stays separate.
Restraint; plain definitions, types for cut (tail, cheeks, fillet).

Restraint. Eel absorbs conger eel (types freshwater eel/unagi, conger/anago); keep Hamanako unagi GI and Comacchio eel once each (dedupe English/Japanese entries); note European eel trade limits (CITES II). Pufferfish: keep Shimonoseki fuku and Awaji 3-year torafugu once each. Cutlassfish: keep Toyoshima tachiuo once.

k.brief: Rename from King George whiting; types King George, sand whiting, kisu.

depts.note: Tier for everyday prawns and mussels; variety for oysters, lobster and crab where growing area or origin is the axis.

b.v: live › fresh cooked › frozen raw › frozen cooked
b.w: Shellfish safety and quality; live bivalves must close when tapped.

b.v: Class A (direct sale) › B › C
b.w: EU/UK bivalve water classification and depuration rules.

b.v: prawns by count per kg/lb; oysters by number (e.g. Fines de claire n°0–5); lobster by weight
b.w: Trade size ladders used on retail labels.

s.brief: Split the single Oyster kind into species kinds; archetypes are growing areas and named producers (oysters by growing area). Pacific oyster: Gillardeau (Spéciale), Fines de claire / Marennes-Oléron PGI (Label Rouge), Huître de Normandie PGI, Breton and Charente sea-born oyster, Kusshi, Fanny Bay, Kumiai, 고흥굴 GI. Native flat oyster: Belon, Colchester Native, Fal Oyster PDO, Galway, Malostonska kamenica PDO, Limfjord. Eastern oyster: Blue Point, Wellfleet, Island Creek, Malpeque, Chesapeake. Kumamoto oyster (Crassostrea sikamea). Sydney rock oyster: Coffin Bay is Pacific; Sydney rock from NSW estuaries. Types for all: live/shucked/half-shell, size grade. Add a tradition entry for Marennes-Oléron claire affinage if a source is found.

k.brief: Gets the old Oyster kind and its models; move native-oyster models (Fal, Malostonska) to Native flat oyster.
Ostrea edulis; Belon, Colchester, Fal, Galway, Limfjord archetypes.
Crassostrea virginica; East Coast US/Canada growing areas.

s.brief: Archetypes by named origin: Eastern Scheldt lobster, Maine lobster, Brittany blue lobster (homard bleu), Banco Chinchorro spiny lobster (move to Spiny lobster), Western Australian rock lobster; snow crab origin brands Matsuba-gani and Echizen-gani; Alaskan/Norwegian red king crab; Yangcheng Lake hairy crab and 七里海河蟹 GI (move to Chinese mitten crab); Chesapeake blue crab / soft-shell; Florida stone crab claws. Rename 'Other crab' to Brown crab (edible crab). Lobster absorbs Lobster tails as type (whole/tails, live/cooked).

k.brief: Rock lobster / langosta; Palinuridae; tails are the main retail form.
Hairy crab / dazhaxie; seasonal autumn crab; Yangcheng Lake origin.
Scylla serrata; live trade in Asia and Australia.

s.brief: Restraint: cut 14 species kinds to market species; types raw/cooked, shell-on/peeled, head-on, size count, wild/farmed, ASC/MSC. Unnamed-species prawns fold into Whiteleg shrimp; blue shrimp is a type there. US Gulf pink, brown and royal red shrimp become one kind.

k.brief: Rename from White shrimp; aliases vannamei · white shrimp.

s.brief: Restraint. Keep mussel PDOs/TSG (Galicia, bouchot, Scardovari, Novigrad, Taranto). Clam types hard clam/quahog, Manila, palourde, surf, tellina, geoduck.

Restraint. Scallop types king/queen/bay/sea, hand-dived/dredged, roe-on/off; keep Isle of Man Queenies PDO and Noda scallop GI. Land snail types Burgundy (Helix pomatia)/petit-gris/gros-gris, live/prepared/tinned.

Restraint. Sea urchin types bafun/murasaki, tray/brine-packed (keep Hamanaka GI). Rename Mixed seafood to Seafood mix (frozen frutti di mare); drop the Slow Food fishery presidia listed as its models (fisheries, not products).

depts.note: Variety for smoked salmon houses and kipper smokehouses; tier for supermarket packs.

b.v: dry-salted › brined; cold-smoked vs hot-smoked; wood (oak, beech, peat, juniper)
b.w: Defines style and texture; smokehouse labelling.

b.v: wild › organic farmed › farmed; Scottish/Irish/Norwegian/Faroese
b.w: Main price driver for smoked salmon.

b.v: Stiftung Warentest · Which? · Ökotest
b.w: Annual smoked salmon tests name winners.

s.brief: Smoked salmon by house: archetypes H. Forman & Son London Cure (London Cure Smoked Salmon PGI), Severn & Wye, Hebridean Smokehouse, Loch Fyne, Ummera, Frank Hederman, Burren Smokehouse, Balik (Fumoir Balik), Petrossian, Kinsale, Ducktrap, Nova lox / belly lox styles; types sliced/whole side/D-cut/hand-carved, wild/farmed. Cut the discounter SKU list (Aldi, Mein Lieblings, Krone, Friedrichs…) to Stiftung Warentest / Which? winners only. Gravlax archetypes: Scandinavian gravad lax; types dill/beetroot. Add brand-register entries for the smokehouses.

Smokehouse icons as archetypes: kipper (Craster/L. Robson & Sons, Manx kipper, Loch Fyne), bloater, buckling; Arbroath smokie PGI (dedupe), finnan haddie, Cullen; Kieler Sprotten; Räucheraal; Schillerlocke; Sunnmøre herring; Danube smoked shad PGI. Smoked trout and mackerel: tier, cut SKU-like models to a few.

depts.note: Conservas by house (variety) at the enthusiast end; tier for mainstream supermarket tuna and sardines.

b.v: olive oil (extra virgin) › sunflower oil › brine/spring water › sauces
b.w: Main label variable and quality signal.

b.v: species named · pole-and-line / MSC · seasonal catch (e.g. Cantabrian spring anchovy) · vintage-dated tins
b.w: Conserva enthusiasts and sustainability guides.

b.v: hand-packed › machine-packed; fillets vs pieces
b.w: Separates artisan conserveiras from mass brands.

s.brief: Cut 82 tuna SKUs to archetypes by house plus mainstream tier: Ortiz Bonito del Norte, Ortiz ventresca, Rio Mare, John West, StarKist, Bumble Bee, Wild Planet, Hagoromo Sea Chicken, Dongwon tuna, Callipo, Tonnino, Ati Manel, Nuri tuna, Petit Navire, Saupiquet; tuna types skipjack/yellowfin, chunk/solid/flaked/ventresca, oil/water. New Bonito del Norte kind for premium tinned albacore (Cantabrian conservas). White fish merges cod, hake, sea bass, whitefish and sturgeon tins as types. Add brand-register entries for conserveiras and mass brands, and tradition entries for Cantabrian/Basque and Portuguese conservas.

k.brief: Tinned albacore from the Cantabrian costera; types loins, ventresca, in oil or escabeche.

s.brief: Cut 117 sardine SKUs to archetypes by house (≤20 models): Nuri (Pinhais) sardines in olive oil, Ramón Peña sardinillas, Connétable, La Belle-Iloise, Ortiz, José Gourmet, Minerva, Cuca, Ati Manel, Bela Olhão, Ramirez, King Oscar, Brunswick, Season, Hagoromo, Millésime/vintage sardines (Rödel, Amieux); types sardinillas/pilchards, skinless-boneless, oil/tomato/spiced. Sprats: Riga Sprats PGI (Rīgas šprotes), King Oscar brisling. Herring: kipper snacks. Mackerel: Kinka saba, La Belle-Iloise. Add traditions: Portuguese conservas (Matosinhos), Breton conserverie, Riga sprats.

Cantabrian anchoas by house: Ortiz, Olasagasti, Don Bocarte, Nardín, Codesa, Conservas Emilia, Santoña houses (Carmelo); Italian alici: Agostino Recca, Scalia, Cetara; salted anchovies in jars as a type; Connétable. Tradition: Santoña anchovy salting (Anchoa del Cantábrico). Marinated herring: rollmops, Bismarck herring, Scandinavian inlagd sill (Abba, Klädesholmen); keep Wakasa Obama kodai sasazuke GI once.

Galician and Catalan conservas by house: Ramón Peña, Los Peperetes, Conservas de Cambados, Espinaler (berberechos, vermouth-hour tradition), Güeyu Mar, Real Conservera Española, Connétable, Angelmo; archetypes such as mussels in escabeche, berberechos al natural, navajas, zamburiñas in salsa, pulpo; Lucky Star / Crown Prince smoked oysters, Chicken of the Sea; Korean golbaengi tins (Yumdong). Types by packing.

depts.note: Variety for sturgeon caviar (species → farm/house); tier for everyday roe.

b.v: species code · source (W wild / C captive-bred) · country · year · lot
b.w: CITES universal caviar labelling system since 2000s; wild Caspian trade banned, almost all caviar is farmed.

b.v: malossol (low salt) · grain size · colour (000 › 0) · firmness
b.w: Caviar house grading ladders.

b.v: beluga › kaluga › osetra › sevruga › baerii; farm country
b.w: Main price driver.

s.brief: Kinds by species; archetypes by farm/house: Petrossian, Caviar House & Prunier, Calvisius (Agroittica Lombarda), Kaviari, Sturia / Caviar d'Aquitaine PGI, Caviar Giaveri, Kaluga Queen (Hangzhou Qiandaohu), Black River (Uruguay), Riofrío (Spain, organic), Royal Belgian Caviar, Mottra, Antonius, Galilee, Regiis Ova, Tsar Nicoulai, Marky's, Baku. Versions = house grades (Imperial, Royal, Prestige). Hybrid absorbs no others. Hackleback and paddlefish are American caviars. Add traditions: Caspian (Iranian/Russian) caviar, Aquitaine farmed caviar. Brand entries for caviar houses.

Archetypes: ikura (Hokkaido shoyu-zuke), Kalix löjrom PDO and Vänerlöjrom, Hakata mentaiko (Fukuya, Yamaya), Kalles Kaviar (smoked cod roe spread) under Cod roe, kazunoko (incl. komochi kombu), tobiko, masago; Bottarga: Cabras mullet bottarga presidium, Orbetello, karasumi (Nagasaki), Trapani tuna bottarga, Greek avgotaraho (Messolonghi PDO). Rename Grey mullet roe to Bottarga with types mullet/tuna, whole/grated.

depts.note: Named traditions (bacalhau, stockfish, matjes, katsuobushi, Chinese dried seafood) are the variety axis.

b.v: bacalhau: Graúdo › Especial › Crescido; dried abalone/conpoy: origin and head count per catty
b.w: Trade grading ladders used in retail.

b.v: salt · air-dried · smoked · fermented
b.w: Defines the product family.

s.brief: Archetypes: Bacalhau de Cura Tradicional Portuguesa TSG, Norwegian klippfisk (Møre og Romsdal); Stockfish from Lofoten PGI (Tørrfisk fra Lofoten), lutefisk as type; Glückstädter Matjes PGI, Hollandse Nieuwe; Mojama de Barbate / Isla Cristina; Fermented fish: surströmming (tin, Röda Ulven, Oskars), rakfisk (Valdres PGI), hákarl, funazushi, kusaya; Salted fermented seafood: jeotgal (saeujeot, myeongnanjeot), shiokara, bagoong, pla ra. Tradition entries for bacalhau, stockfish, surströmming.

Katsuobushi: honkarebushi, arabushi, Makurazaki GI (dedupe), Yaizu; types block/kezuribushi flakes. Niboshi (dried sardines/anchovies: iriko, myeolchi, ikan bilis). Dried pollock (hwangtae from Inje/Yongdae-ri, bugeo). Keep Shinan dried rockfish GI once. Shark fin: note trade bans and CITES listings; kind stays, no models.

k.brief: Small dried sardines/anchovies for stock and snacks.

s.brief: Chinese dried seafood (haimei): archetypes by origin and grade: Japanese dried abalone (Yoshihama, Oma, Amidori), Hokkaido conpoy, Japanese dried sea cucumber (Hokkaido/Kanto), Hiyama sea cucumber GI; dried oyster (hao si); types by size count. Squid absorbs cuttlefish (types squid, cuttlefish, shredded snack).

k.brief: Hao si; sun-dried or semi-dried oysters, Chinese New Year staple.

depts.note: Processed fish products; Japanese nerimono traditions as archetypes.

b.v: % fish declared; whole fillet › minced
b.w: Consumer tests (Which?, Stiftung Warentest, CHOICE) rank fish fingers and fish cakes on fish content.

s.brief: Nerimono archetypes: Odawara kamaboko, Sendai sasa-kamaboko, narutomaki, Toyohashi chikuwa, Kagoshima satsuma-age, hanpen as a kamaboko type; crab stick: Kanizanmai, Hobo Kani; fish sausage: Maruha Nichiro / Nissui; fish ball: Teochew fish balls, Norwegian fiskeboller (tinned). Trim fish sausage SKUs.

Tier: Fish fingers (Birds Eye/Iglo/Findus, Gorton's, Young's; Which?/Stiftung Warentest winners); Breaded & battered fish (fillets, scampi); Fish cakes (Western, potato-and-fish); Gefilte fish (jarred: Manischewitz, Rokeach); Fish pâté & rillettes (La Belle-Iloise rillettes, taramasalata, smoked mackerel pâté).

k.brief: Breaded fish sticks; frozen; Birds Eye 1955 launch.
Frozen coated fillets and scampi; types breaded/battered/fillet/portion.
Western potato-and-fish patty, chilled or frozen.
Ashkenazi poached fish balls, usually jarred.
